text: Assumption: Dcm_MsgItemType corresponds to a byte type (e.g. uint8) — is this correct?
text_en: Assumption: Dcm_MsgItemType corresponds to a byte type (e.g. uint8) — is this correct?
norm: dcm_msgitemtype corresponds to a byte type e g uint8
assumption: Dcm_MsgItemType corresponds to a byte type (e.g. uint8).
rationale: SWS_Dcm_00990 declares Dcm_MsgType as pointer Dcm_MsgItemType*, but does not specify the base type further in the payload.
